R0238.title: Fake Conversion and Install Farm
R0238.definition: Fraud operators use device farms and scripts to simulate registrations, installs, retention, and conversions.
R0238.description:
Fake conversion and install farms use device farms, emulators, scripts, or crowdsourced labor to simulate registration, installation, retention, purchases, or other funnel events. The goal is to obtain CPA, CPS, acquisition subsidies, or platform rewards.

These actions look valid in funnel metrics but lack real user value. Platforms need device fingerprinting, behavior sequence analysis, retention quality checks, payment linkage, and channel profiling.
R0238.influence: Fake conversions consume acquisition budget, pollute growth metrics, and push teams to scale low-quality channels.
